quote: On November 5, 2026, Alphabet Inc. ("Alphabet") closed its underwritten public offering of €6 billion aggregate principal amount of euro-denominated senior notes (the "Notes") pursuant to Alphabet's registration statement on Form S-3 (File No. 333-296395).
